hero.title: Instant Booking & Quote Calculator
hero.subline: Calculate your exact rental rate, choose your vehicle, and reserve instantly via WhatsApp with zero hassle.

steps.title: Select Your Vehicle
steps.desc: Browse our diverse fleet of scooters, automatic bikes, hybrid cars, and spacious passenger vans suited for your trip.

steps.title: Choose Dates & Location
steps.desc: Specify your pickup & drop-off dates, preferred delivery location in Kandy or airport, and any accessories.

steps.title: WhatsApp Confirmation
steps.desc: Receive a quick official quote with transparent breakdown, deposit instructions, and priority vehicle allocation.

policies.title: 200 Free KM Daily
policies.desc: All rentals come with a generous 200 free kilometers per 24 hours. Extra distance is billed at vehicle specific rates.

policies.title: Fuel Policy (Same-to-Same)
policies.desc: Vehicles are provided with fuel and must be returned at the same level upon return to avoid refueling surcharge.

policies.title: Refundable Security Deposit
policies.desc: Rs. 5,000 for bikes & Rs. 10,000 - 20,000 for cars. 100% refunded immediately upon vehicle return inspection.

policies.title: License Requirements
policies.desc: Valid Sri Lankan driving license or International Driving Permit (IDP) / AA Ceylon endorsement with passport.

cta.title: Need Immediate Road Trip Advice?
cta.text: Call or message our 24/7 hotline directly for same-day emergency rentals or customized multi-day tour itineraries.
